concepts.label: Prometheus Metrics Format (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - Sync Gateway's flat-JSON Prometheus-compatible encoding. Checked against the extraction-layer prometheus:metrics-endpoint (Couchbase Server's own /metrics endpoint, from server/8.0/manage/monitor/set-up-prometheus-for-monitoring.json) and kept separate per the same no-silent-merge convention used for tool:sgcollect-info vs tool:cbcollect-info: both are 'a Couchbase service exposing Prometheus-compatible metrics' in near-identical wording, but this page states only that Sync Gateway follows the SAME pattern as other services ('As with all Couchbase services, Sync Gateway exposes a Prometheus-compatible format'), not that it IS the same endpoint or shares implementation - a stated family resemblance, not a stated identity, so kept as its own concept rather than reusing prometheus:metrics-endpoint outright.

notable_absence.finding: This overview page names no individual stat or metric itself (that detail is deferred entirely to the JSON and Prometheus sub-pages) - so no monitoredVia relations are minted here; they belong to stats-monitoring-json.json and stats-monitoring-prometheus.json instead, written later in this batch.

cross_component_finding: None beyond what is captured above - this page is purely a format-choice overview with no operational/procedural content of its own.
cross_product_finding: The isAnalogousTo relation above is this batch's second same-shape-different-product finding (after tool:sgcollect-info/tool:cbcollect-info and alongside sgw:tombstone/storage:tombstone), and it sits at a THIRD distinct point on the spectrum between them: sgcollect_info/cbcollect_info state no relationship at all (kept fully separate); sgw:tombstone/storage:tombstone state literal identity under a condition (isVariantOf); this page states neither identity nor silence but an explicit stated FAMILY RESEMBLANCE ('as with all Couchbase services') without claiming the endpoints are the same thing - motivating the choice of isAnalogousTo (a weaker, comparison-only predicate) over isVariantOf here.
